name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=settings-dialog UI, descriptor=repaint-borders. Verb 'repaint' accurately reflects being re-invoked every idle frame from fd2_wait_input_with_dialog_repaint to redraw the 4 corner border sprites (with blink on the selected corner). No address residue; constants in the body (0x2AC0 stride, 0x8088 anchor, *3/*2 sprite-frame multipliers, 0x1C8 blit stride) are framebuffer geometry, not IDs.
purpose: Per-frame repaint of a settings dialog's 4 corner border sprites, blinking the currently-selected corner; called from the dialog idle/repaint loop.
logic_summary: Saves the char index under the cursor for later restamp; computes the panel anchor in the work buffer from the on-screen cursor cell (base 0x8088 + cursor_x*0x18 + cursor_y*0x2AC0). Uses the fixed 4-corner offsets [-0x23A0, +0x378, +0x3A8, +0x2AC0] (same as close-slide initial state). For each corner c in 0..3: sprite_id = menu_options[c]*3 + menu_state[c]*2; if c equals data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx, add data_fd2_dialog_blink_phase_oscillator (0/1) to alternate frames; resolve sprite_addr via the dialog-state handle's dword offset table; blit at panel_anchor+corner_offset with stride 0x1C8. After the loop, if a char was under the cursor (idx != -1), restamp it via fd2_paint_char_sprite_at_world_pos.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Pointer (as uint) to the int32[4] menu_options array; each entry is the per-corner sprite base index multiplied by 3 to compute the atlas index. Forwarded unmodified from the caller fd2_wait_input_with_dialog_repaint. src already declares this as 'menu_options'.

params.semantics: Pointer (as uint) to the int32[4] menu_state array; each entry is the per-corner state index multiplied by 2 to compute the atlas index. Forwarded unmodified from the caller. src already declares this as 'menu_state'.

returns.semantics: No return value; effect is the 4 corner sprites (and restamped cursor char) drawn into the work buffer.
